observations: Multiple office chairs lined up outdoors on a dirt/concrete surface.
The chairs are wrapped in thin protective plastic.
Some chairs have chrome-finished five-star bases, while others have black plastic bases.
All visible chairs feature armrests and casters.
No manufacturer labels, brand names, or model numbers are visible on the frames or bases.

claims.evidence: The levers are obscured by the plastic or the angle of the shots; functionality cannot be confirmed.
Photo 0 and 1 clearly show five-point bases equipped with casters.

risks.risk: The gas lift mechanism for height adjustment may be failed or seized.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the lever being operated and the chair successfully holding weight at different heights.

risks.risk: Upholstery may be torn, stained, or worn beneath the plastic wrapping.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat and backrest with the plastic removed.

risks.risk: Casters (wheels) may be cracked or unable to roll smoothly.
risks.proof: A video of the chair being rolled across a flat floor.

proof_requests: Video demonstrating the height adjustment lever and gas lift functionality.
Photos of the chairs with the plastic wrapping removed to inspect the fabric/leather condition.
Clear photo of any manufacturer labels under the seat.
response.reason: The items are standard office chairs. While mechanical and upholstery conditions are unverified, they can be priced at the worst-case value for generic used office furniture.
